messages:
nina.billing: FYI incoming wire posted this morning for $12,350.00 from BetaLabs Ltd — bank message shows truncated reference. original remittance reportedly included \"INV4510-BETA/PO-998\", but bank statement shows \"INV4510-BETA\" only. no remittance email in our support ticket.
kevin.treasury: ack. do we have bank's value date / bank txn id? can we match by amount + value date?
alice.recon: please grab the raw MT103 from the bank portal if available; sometimes the ordering customer field still has the full narrative.
nina.billing: bank portal snippet below (copied from their portal):
```
MT103
20:TRX1794201023
50:/40087654 BETALABS LTD
59:/ACCT/94007890 REDWOOD INFERENCE
70:INV4510-BETA/PO-998
```
note: their portal appears to truncate anything after a space or slash on some rails, on the bank statement we only see \"INV4510-BETA\". suspect correspondent bank stripped trailing segment.
kevin.treasury: thanks. customer (billing@betalabs.com) says they emailed payment advice with full PO reference. can they forward the original remittance to billing@redwood.com so we have evidence?
tom.accounts: quick triage plan:
1) request customer to forward original remittance and include transaction trace/reference from their bank.
2) open a SWIFT trace (MT199/MT999) with our bank to retrieve full remittance text from correspondent using bank_txn_id and value date.
3) pause auto-apply rules for matches within +/- 2 days and same amount until we confirm mapping.
alice.recon: I'll scan the unapplied receipts for amount $12,350 and value date 2026-03-10 and check our auto-apply logs. sometimes the system applied to a different open invoice because suffix was missing.
payments-bot: @nina.billing Created ticket PAY-7940. Sent MT199 trace request to correspondent (BIC: RBWDGB21) referencing TRX1794201023. Bank ETA 48-96h. Ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PAY-7940 :white_check_mark:
kevin.treasury: if bank confirms that the suffix was stripped in transit, customer's remittance email + bank trace should be sufficient for allocation — no refund/recredit required. finance needs the email and the bank trace for audit trail.
alice.recon: noted. I'll add a heuristic to the reconciliation service to flag 'likely-truncated-ref' when the narrative contains separators ("/" or "-") and the statement field is a strict prefix of the MT103 70: narrative. we'll surface flagged items in the unreconciled queue.
tom.accounts: also add a quick check for common invoice tokens (INV, PO, SO) in ordering party fields; alert ops if we detect potential loss of suffix.
nina.billing: customer has forwarded remittance and attached a PDF with full ref \"INV4510-BETA/PO-998\" — attached to PAY-7940. uploading to ticket now.
kevin.treasury: once bank trace confirms, allocate to invoice INV4510 and close PAY-7940. tom, please prepare a short customer-facing confirmation message accepting the remittance as proof of payment.
tom.accounts: drafting now, will send via billing@redwood.com once reconciliation is done. :thumbsup:
alice.recon: updating logs — placing a hold on auto-apply for that amount window. will update thread when match is complete.
nina.billing: thanks everyone. will update when bank trace returns. :eyes:
